title: The Last Lighthouse (3/3): Burn It All (Finale)

scenes.narration: Dozens of boats. Heading straight for the rocks. And the light that guided them... is dead.
The generator is finished. No fuel. No spare parts. Nothing.
But a lighthouse doesn't need electricity. It needs fire. That's how they worked... for hundreds of years.
So you grab everything that will burn. The chairs. The table. The bookshelf.
Juno carries the logbooks. Three years of the same line. No ships. Nobody.
scenes.visual: girl carrying a stack of logbooks

scenes.narration: You stop her for a second. Then you take the first book... and you light it.
The fire catches. The great glass lens turns it into a beam... brighter than it's ever been.
Out in the storm, the boats turn. One by one... they find the channel.
You keep feeding the fire all night. Juno passes you the books. Pepper watches from the stairs.
scenes.visual: feeding the fire, cat on the stairs

scenes.narration: By dawn, the storm is gone. And the little cove... is full of boats.
Families. Kids. Old people. A hundred and forty strangers... who thought they were the last ones.
And then Juno screams... and runs down the rocks.
A man in a torn jacket is climbing off the last boat. He steered for the light. He made it.
For three years, you kept a light burning for nobody. Turns out... somebody was always watching.
scenes.visual: you at the top of the tower at sunrise, cat beside you

scenes.narration: What would you have burned to keep the light on? Tell me in the comments... and follow. Tomorrow... a new story.
scenes.visual: end card: THE END / NEW STORY TOMORROW
